• Mirabai Chanu won a silver medal at Tokyo Olympics 2020 on 24 July 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India has won 7 medals in Tokyo Olympics 2021 - 1 Gold Medal, 2 Silver medals, and 4 Bronze medals. 
 
 
• The 23-year old **Neeraj Chopra** won India’s first-ever Gold in Athletics after finishing on top of the podium in the Javelin Throw.

 
 
• He also became only the second individual Gold medalist for the country at the Summer Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Abhinav Bindra had won the country’s first individual Gold after winning the 10m Air Rifle event at the 2008 Beijing Olympics**
 
• **PV Sindhu** wins bronze medal in women's singles shuttler PV Sindhu becomes first Indian woman to win two individual medals at Olympic Games.
 
 
• She had won the Silver at the 2016 Games held at Rio. She also became the first Indian player to win the World Badminton Championship and two Olympic medals across genders.
 
• She had won the World Championship in 2019.
 
 
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya** gets India a Silver medal in the Tokyo Olympics.
 
• **Lovlina Borogohain** fetched a Bronze medal for India in Tokyo Olympics.
 
• **Indian Hockey men team is also won the Bronze medal.**
